calendars.scope: Common full-day public-holiday dates across the eight Australian states and mainland territories in 2026
limitations: Common-date baseline only, not a complete Commonwealth FOI, state, territory or local calendar.
State/territory and local dates must be selected explicitly; external territories are not covered.
Public-holiday source checking does not establish statutory applicability.

calendars.scope: Australian Capital Territory: published full-day calendar
limitations: Territory-wide full-day public holidays.
Does not include the bank-only holiday on 3 August.
Public-holiday data only; verify the relevant statute, authority and location before using a deadline.

calendars.scope: New South Wales: published full-day calendar
limitations: Statewide full-day dates only; declared local public holidays and part-day holidays require separate location-specific data.
The 3 August bank holiday is NOT a declared NSW public holiday. Local event days are also not public holidays.
Public-holiday data only; verify the relevant statute, authority and location before using a deadline.

calendars.scope: Northern Territory: published full-day calendar
limitations: Territory-wide full-day dates only; regional show days require separate location-specific data.
24 and 31 December are part-day public holidays (19:00 to midnight), not full-day exclusions.
No substitute Anzac Day on 27 April.
Public-holiday data only; verify the relevant statute, authority and location before using a deadline.

calendars.scope: Tasmania general public holidays: published full-day calendar
limitations: Statewide general full-day holidays only.
Easter Tuesday 7 April generally applies to the Tasmanian Public Service and is not included in the general calendar.
Regional holidays differ by municipal and locality boundaries; a simple north/south split is insufficient.
Boxing Day is substituted to 28 December; 26 December is not a second public holiday in 2026.
Neither Easter Saturday nor Easter Sunday is a Tasmanian public holiday in 2026; no substitute Anzac Day.
Public-holiday data only; verify the relevant statute, authority and location before using a deadline.
